name: lasagna
description: Spec-driven TDD harness for Claude Code. Precise spec, frozen contract, then a red-green loop built in vertical slices, where the agent writing the test and the agent writing the code never share context: the implementer can neither read nor write tests. Rigid on process, flexible on architecture: functional core / imperative shell in proportion to the project, and existing conventions adopted, not converted. Three human gates, a per-criterion cycle budget, traceability from acceptance criteria to tests. Hooks need Python >= 3.9.
